turns.message: I know chlorophyll absorbs light but I cannot see how photon energy ends up stored in ATP and NADPH.

scripted_assessment.root_problem: How light reactions convert absorbed photons into ATP and NADPH

turns.message: I understand what the SA node is, but why do specific ion currents make its membrane potential slowly rise on its own?

scripted_assessment.root_problem: Mechanism of ion-current-driven spontaneous depolarization of SA node cells

turns.message: At the battery terminals the voltage seems lower while current is flowing. Why does the battery behave that way?

scripted_assessment.root_problem: Why terminal voltage decreases under load due to battery internal resistance

turns.message: When a particle goes through the double-slit apparatus, why do the detected particles form fringes when we do not observe which slit?

scripted_assessment.root_problem: The mechanism of the double-slit interference pattern without which-path detection

scripted_assessment.root_problem: How SA node pacemaker depolarization differs from neuronal action potential initiation

scripted_assessment.root_problem: How carbon dioxide is fixed into organic molecules during the Calvin cycle
